I have been getting my lashes done for over 5 years. I’ve gone to lash studios all over, even in other countries, and Jenna is my favorite lash tech I’ve ever had!!!! She’s always so kind and gentle. Most techs make my lashes too thick and heavy for my face. I am half-Asian so I also struggle with lashes fitting the shape of my eye. Jenna did my lashes perfectly and worked with me to find a look that worked well with my eyes. It was my first time having LED extensions too and I truly noticed a difference in how long they lasted. I would go in for a classic fill every 3 weeks, and they would still look pretty good at the end of the 3 weeks. Jenna is also just so accommodating and kind. I’ve called to switch my appointment times multiple times and she’s always willing to work with me, even coming in earlier on the weekends. She always makes sure I’m comfortable with the blanket and my music playing in my headphones before she starts. She’s the best!!!! I recommend Jenna and Lashiskin to anyone looking in DC to get their lashes done!

I had another amazing experience at LASHISKIN, thank you ❤️ I actually live in Germany, and I first got my lash extensions here during a trip to Washington, D.C. last year. I was so impressed that I made sure to come back again during my vacation this year. My lash extensions lasted a long time, looked beautiful the entire time, and most importantly, they did not damage my natural lashes at all. The technician is  incredibly skilled and take the time to create a look that suits your eyes while keeping your natural lashes healthy. The salon is spotless, elegant, and has such a relaxing atmosphere. Everyone is welcoming, professional, and genuinely passionate about their work.  Last year I also purchased their mascara, and it exceeded all my expectations. Every mascara I’ve ever used, even luxury brands, has smudged under my eyes by the end of the day. LASHISKIN’s mascara is completely different. Even though it’s not waterproof, it stayed perfect all day without smudging, flaking, or transferring. At the same time, it came off effortlessly with just micellar water, so there was no need to rub or irritate my lashes. I highly recommend LASHISKIN to anyone looking for high-quality lash services and products. Love it 🥰
